blocks.text: CALIFORNIA — In a surprise move, Nvidia’s board reinstated Jensen Huang as president and CEO on Monday, just days after rejecting his offer to return to the artificial intelligence chipmaker where he built a reputation as one of the industry’s leading evangelists. It was the latest twist in the fallout from Huang’s admission of an affair with a woman suspected of being a Chinese spy. “The Board believes Jensen is the right person to lead Nvidia, and that his reinstatement is in the best interests of our stockholders, employees, partners and customers,” board chair Harvey C. Jones said in a statement. […]... Keep on reading: Nvidia board reinstates Jensen Huang as CEO
